design_philosophy: Inspired by OpenAI, Stripe, Vercel. Minimal, Enterprise-grade, Black and white, Lots of whitespace, Clean typography, Premium feel. 95% monochrome with color as function only.

spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for containers to create breathing room. Do not cramp elements.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6 for Dashboards. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-8 to gap-12 for Landing page.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: max 8px (rounded-lg). Prefer rounded-md or rounded-sm for inputs and buttons. No bubbly shapes.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and forms. Avoid centering unless it's a specific hero statement.

surfaces_and_shadows.cards: Flat solid background with a crisp 1px border (border-border). No default shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-sm).
surfaces_and_shadows.glassmorphism: Only for sticky headers: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/50.
surfaces_and_shadows.grid_borders: For the analytics and marketplace section, use 'border-collapse' style with border-r and border-b on grid items to expose the 'Technical Skeleton'.
surfaces_and_shadows.hover_states: Always explicitly define hover:bg and hover:text to ensure high contrast.

components.buttons: Shadcn Button. Primary: bg-black text-white hover:bg-black/90. Secondary: border border-input bg-transparent hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground. Use data-testid on all.
components.inputs: Shadcn Input, Select, Form. Use standard h-10 with crisp 1px borders.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Used heavily in the Analytics dashboard.
components.dialogs: Shadcn Dialog. Dark backdrop (bg-black/40) with sharp white modal surface.
components.badges: Minimal. Bordered with transparent background or soft gray (bg-muted).
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Monochrome lines and bars (black, dark gray, light gray). No colorful pies unless representing bad/good (red/black).

motion.transitions: Fast and precise. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.hover: Translate Y (-1px) for cards, subtle background color shifts for list items.

image_urls.description: Gray digital wallpaper lattice. Use for landing page abstract background or hero banner section (with overlay).
Curved white latticework. Use for agent builder empty states or marketplace background texture.
Pexels logo on black. Use as a 'trusted by' company logo on the landing page.
Kraft logo on black. Use as a 'trusted by' company logo on the landing page.
Black and white portrait of woman at desk. Use in 'Hire AI Employees' section or testimonial.

media.hero_overlay: bg-white/40 to bg-white/70 gradient, ensuring text contrast if placed over abstract white/gray background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts: Outfit, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono.
Update tailwind.config.js and index.css to use the minimalist monochromatic color palette defined here.
Use grid layouts with 1px border on children for the 'dashboard analytics' to give it a technical framework feel.
Do NOT use gradients unless it's a subtle white/gray background wash.
Rely heavily on typography tracking and weights for hierarchy. Keep UI adornments to a minimum.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Ensure 'Agent Builder' and 'Chat' interfaces feel like IDEs or high-end technical tools (monospace fonts for labels/data, strict margins).
